_comment: Every threshold in the estate pricing engine. Edit this file, restart nothing - it is read per call. Percentages are fractions (0.15 = 15%).

price_bands._comment: Applied to the median of the comparable set.

confidence._comment: Score components sum to 1.0. Result maps through thresholds below.

deadline._comment: Hard move-out and disposition deadline for this sale. The environment variable ESTATE_MOVE_OUT_DATE overrides this; the value here is the fallback so urgency still applies if the variable is missing. Everything must be sold, donated, or removed by this date.

markdown._comment: Cadence and step size. Step is applied to the CURRENT price. Calibrated 2026-08-02 for the 2026-08-31 deadline: a 7-day first markdown and a 5-day interval fit roughly four markdown cycles into the window. Loosen both if the deadline moves out.
markdown._deadline_endgame_note: The endgame percentage is a FLOOR applied on top of the accumulated step, not a replacement for it. It must exceed base_step_pct plus the urgent_deadline modifier, or the final week would be gentler than the week before. Raised to 0.30 on 2026-08-02 for the 2026-08-31 hard deadline: in the last seven days the realistic alternative to a deep discount is a skip.

bundle._comment: Indicative multi-item discounts shown on the public catalogue. Tunable here without a deploy - the site generator reads this file at build time and bakes the resulting table into the pages. Tiers must be listed in ascending min_items order and ascending discount_pct order.
bundle._floor_rule: A bundle discount may NEVER take any selected item below its approved floor_price. Each item is published with a discount BAND - the index of the deepest tier that item can absorb without breaching its floor - and the discount actually applied to a basket is the minimum of the count-based tier and every selected item's band. The floor prices themselves are never published; see docs/CATALOGUE.md.

pickup_incentive._comment: Dollar discount offered for local pickup, derived from cost avoided. Capped as a fraction of current price.

fees._comment: Effective seller cost as a fraction of sale price, INCLUDING payment processing where the platform bundles it. Used only to estimate net proceeds.
fees._verified: Checked via web search on 2026-08-02. Platforms change fees often - re-verify before relying on these for a large sale. Sources listed in docs/estate/MARKETPLACES.md.
